preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m must be within the range of 1 to 2000.
The starting cell coordinates r and c must be valid indices within the labyrinth.
The maximum allowed movements to the left x and to the right y must be non-negative and within the specified limits.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in labyrinth) and all(cell in '.*' for row in labyrinth for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each row of the labyrinth must have exactly m characters, and each character must be either '.' or '*'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of reachable cells from the starting cell, including the starting cell itself.
